dedupe_keys.name: traffic volume trends monthly us traffic change report from continuous counters fhwa

description: Traffic Volume Trends is a monthly report published by the Federal Highway Administration's Office of Highway Policy Information, based on hourly traffic count data reported by the states. The data come from about 5,000 continuous traffic counting locations nationwide and are used to estimate the percentage change in traffic for the current month compared with the same month a year earlier; the estimates are later re-adjusted. The page links to the reports and a list of frequently asked questions. Coverage: the United States, by state and road type. Format and access: free monthly reports. Licence and cost: free; no licence is stated on the page. Caveats: estimates of change, not counts at every site, and figures are revised. It supports network flow and resilience studies, for instance measuring the drop and recovery of travel after disasters or pandemics. It relates to HPMS and Caltrans PeMS in the catalogue.
